title: Sweetwater Grade 4 lesson plan, week of Nov 16
scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[11/16 | Science, Questions (Remember/Recall)] The four main processes of the water cycle are evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and runoff.
[11/16 | Science, Questions (Apply)] Gravity is the force that pulls precipitation down to the ground.
[11/16 | Math, Retrieval Activator] Solve: 848 ÷ 4 using any division strategy (e.g., area model or partial quotients).
[11/16 | Science, Daily Instructional Plan, Wednesday] Students will play a game to explore the multiple pathways a drop of water can take as it moves through the water cycle.
[11/16 | Math, Vocabulary (review)] divide, dividend, division, divisor, quotient, remainder
[11/16 | Science, Success Criteria] Explain the processes of evaporation, condensation, and precipitation.
[11/16 | Math, Standard] I can divide up to four-digit dividends by one-digit divisors.
[11/16 | Science, Standard (4E3B Water Cycle)] I can use investigations and models to explain how water changes form and travels through the water cycle in different ways.
[11/16 | Math, Daily Instructional Plan] Monday: Session 1
